metrics_modal.title: Metric Dictionary & Data Origin
metrics_modal.subtitle: Definitions, formulas, official sources and calculation rules
metrics_modal.guide_desc: Select a metric to understand what it measures, where its data comes from and how its result is calculated.
metrics_modal.m_war_form: Logistics Cost (%) = Total Logistics Cost ÷ Gross Production Value
metrics_modal.m_war_conc: Percentage of total logistics handling costs relative to the gross production value of TVs.
metrics_modal.m_war_src: War Room Report, “Logistic” sheet, row 67. Received by weekly operational email.
metrics_modal.m_war_biz: Measures logistics efficiency relative to factory output. As production grows, nominal freight may increase, while the percentage should decrease or remain stable through scale gains.
metrics_modal.m_war_ex: Jan/26: 5.4% actual against a 6.5% ceiling results in approximately 120% target achievement (green).
metrics_modal.m_air_form:
Monthly = Freight Amount ÷ Material Cost
Annual ACC = Σ Freight Amount ÷ Σ Material Cost
metrics_modal.m_air_conc: Share of unplanned emergency air freight costs in relation to total TV material cost.
metrics_modal.m_air_src: Freight Air monthly report, “Annual Result” sheet, rows 8 and 9. Received by monthly email; manual entry remains available.
metrics_modal.m_air_biz: Tracks supply shortages and component delays that require urgent transportation. A target is available from 2026; 2024 and 2025 are historical periods without a target.
metrics_modal.m_air_val: The calculated annual ACC is checked against the accumulated columns available in the source report. Divergences must be reviewed.
metrics_modal.m_air_ex: Jul/26: 0.358% actual against a 0.22% target results in 61.36% achievement (red).
metrics_modal.m_resin_form: Net Saving = Gross Saving (20 ft container) − Global Costs − Brazilian Taxes (34.39%)
metrics_modal.m_resin_conc: Net financial saving generated by consolidating plastic resin shipments in 40 ft containers instead of 20 ft containers.
metrics_modal.m_resin_src: Incidental Cost report, “Resin Consolidation” sheet. Received by monthly operational email.
metrics_modal.m_resin_biz: Positive saving represents a direct productivity gain. Quarterly, semiannual and annual results are accumulated by sum.
metrics_modal.m_resin_stat: No target-achievement status is displayed for this indicator.
metrics_modal.m_resin_ex: Jun/26: USD 3.34 K in net saving generated by the Manaus operation.
metrics_modal.m_task_form: Achieved Reduction = Budgeted Costs − Actual Costs
metrics_modal.m_task_conc: Nominal reduction in logistics task and process costs delivered by the team.
metrics_modal.m_task_src: Task Cost Reduction spreadsheet and monthly controlling report.
metrics_modal.m_task_biz: Measures continuous operational cost-reduction projects. Quarterly, semiannual and annual results are accumulated by sum.
metrics_modal.m_task_ex: Jun/26: BRL 688 K in accumulated reduction against a BRL 641 K target.
metrics_modal.m_demurrage_form: Demurrage = Number of containers retained beyond free time
metrics_modal.m_demurrage_conc: Total containers charged additional daily fees due to delays in unloading and returning empty equipment.
metrics_modal.m_demurrage_src: Demurrage Cost report and shipping-line empty-container return control.
metrics_modal.m_demurrage_biz: The target is exactly zero containers. Any value above zero represents financial loss and an operational delay.
metrics_modal.m_demurrage_stat: Green: 0 containers · Red: more than 0 containers
metrics_modal.m_demurrage_ex: A period with 5 containers beyond free time is classified as red.
metrics_modal.m_inc_form: Incidental Cost Ratio = Incidental Cost (MUSD) ÷ Production Amount (MUSD)
metrics_modal.m_inc_conc: Relationship between incidental logistics expenditure and the corresponding production amount.
metrics_modal.m_inc_src: Incidental Cost_Total report, “Incidental Cost (MUSD)” sheet: row 82 (cost), row 95 (production) and row 96 (reported ratio). Received by monthly email.
metrics_modal.m_inc_biz: Monthly values are calculated directly. Quarterly, semiannual and annual results use the sum of cost divided by the sum of production.
metrics_modal.m_inc_val: The calculated monthly ratio is checked against the percentage reported on row 96 for the same year and month.
metrics_modal.m_inc_stat: Not applicable. This indicator has no fixed target and no target-achievement status.
